name: @pipeworx/mcp-madrid-events

tools.name: events
tools.description: Find cultural events & activities in Madrid, Spain (next ~100 days). Filter by keyword, free admission, and date window. Returns events with venue, address, geo, audience and price. Content is in Spanish.

query.description: Keyword over title, description and venue, e.g. "música", "exposición", "teatro".

from.description: Include events on/after this date YYYY-MM-DD (default: today).

to.description: Include events starting on/before this date YYYY-MM-DD.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-madrid-events forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the madrid-events pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
